name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospital cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year across empanelled public and private hospitals.
benefits: Up to Rs. 5 lakh cashless hospitalization cover per family per year.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA Health ID)
description: Create a 14-digit ABHA Health ID to link prescriptions, lab diagnostics, and hospital discharge summaries digitally.
benefits: Unified digital health locker and interoperable consent-based record sharing.

name: Ayushman Vaya Vandana Senior Citizen Cover (70+)
description: Free Rs. 5 lakh annual health insurance cover for all senior citizens aged 70 years and above regardless of income.
benefits: Rs. 5 lakh dedicated annual hospitalisation cover for seniors 70+.

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
description: One-time financial assistance up to Rs. 15 lakh for BPL patients suffering from major life-threatening illnesses treated at government super-specialty hospitals.
benefits: Up to Rs. 15 lakh grant for heart, kidney, cancer, and critical surgeries at government hospitals.

name: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme (National Trust)
description: Affordable Rs. 1 lakh comprehensive health insurance cover for persons with autism, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability, and multiple disabilities.
benefits: Up to Rs. 1 lakh OPD, therapy, surgery, and hospitalisation reimbursement without pre-insurance medical tests.

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons (ADIP Scheme)
description: Financial assistance for purchase of modern, standard aids and assistive appliances for persons with benchmark disabilities.
benefits: Subsidised wheelchairs, hearing aids, prosthetics, Braille kits, and motorised tricycles.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card Portal
description: Single-window national disability identity card for seamless access to central and state health, travel, and pension entitlements.
benefits: Unified verified disability identity card accepted nationwide across hospitals and welfare portals.

name: Deendayal Divyangjan Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
description: Support for rehabilitation centres, physiotherapy clinics, early intervention, and special education services for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Free community rehabilitation, speech therapy, and assistive care through registered centres.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) & JSSK
description: Safe motherhood intervention providing cash assistance and free institutional delivery, C-section, diagnostics, and transport for pregnant women.
benefits: Cash incentive plus 100% free institutional delivery, medicines, blood, and ambulance transport.

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (TB Nutrition & Care)
description: Direct Benefit Transfer of Rs. 1,000 per month nutritional support alongside free TB diagnostics and medicines for all notified TB patients.
benefits: Rs. 1,000 monthly DBT nutrition allowance and free treatment via government DOTS centres.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
description: Free haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis services for BPL patients at district hospitals across India.
benefits: Free regular dialysis sessions at district government hospitals.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Quality generic medicines and surgical consumables at 50% to 90% lower prices through 14,000+ Janaushadhi Kendras.
benefits: 50%-90% savings on chronic cardiac, diabetes, oncology, and antibiotic medicines.

name: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
description: Comprehensive medical care for central government employees, pensioners, and their dependent family members.
benefits: Cashless OPD, diagnostic tests, specialist referral, and empanelled hospital indoor care.

name: ESIC Medical & Cash Sickness Benefit
description: Full medical care and cash sickness/maternity compensation for insured workers earning up to Rs. 21,000/month and their families.
benefits: Unlimited cashless medical treatment at ESIC hospitals & dispensaries with no expenditure cap.

name: Tele-MANAS National Mental Health Helpline (14416)
description: Free 24x7 multilingual tele-mental health counselling and psychiatric referral service across all states and union territories.
benefits: Free 24/7 confidential counselling, psychiatric teleconsult, and crisis support on 14416.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Cashless secondary & tertiary care up to Rs. 5 lakh per family across Maharashtra network hospitals.
benefits: Up to Rs. 5 lakh/year cashless surgery & specialist care across 1,356+ procedures.

name: Swasthya Sathi (West Bengal Health Assurance)
description: Smart-card cashless family health cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per annum for all permanent resident families of West Bengal.
benefits: Rs. 5 lakh annual paperless smart-card hospital cover with pre-existing disease coverage.

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri / Dr. YSR Aarogyasri (Telangana & AP)
description: Cashless surgical and critical inpatient coverage for low-income families in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Up to Rs. 10 lakh (Telangana) / Rs. 25 lakh (AP) cashless tertiary treatment cover.

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance (Tamil Nadu)
description: Annual family cover of Rs. 5 lakh for diagnostic procedures, surgical treatment, and follow-up care in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Rs. 5 lakh/year cashless hospitalisation cover across 1,090+ medical procedures.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly social security pension administered through state social welfare departments for persons with severe disabilities.
benefits: Monthly disability pension credited via DBT; topped up by state welfare grants.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Educational and assistive allowance for students with disabilities studying in classes IX and X.
benefits: Monthly maintenance, book grant, and disability reader/escort allowance.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance support for students with disabilities pursuing higher education.
benefits: Tuition reimbursement plus disability maintenance allowance via National Scholarship Portal.

name: Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Health & Welfare
description: Medical reimbursement, maternity, and accident disability insurance for registered construction workers.
benefits: Cashless/reimbursed medical care, accident cover, and maternity support.

name: PM Vishwakarma Artisan Support & Credit
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, toolkit grant, and collateral-free enterprise credit.
benefits: Rs. 15,000 toolkit e-voucher, Rs. 500/day stipend during training, and 5% interest loan.
